The '''Ganzik system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was located near the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], and was home to [[Mesens Corporation]]'s orbital [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganzik]].
